name: cdb90
title: CDB90 Battle Dataset
description:
A database of over 600 battles that were fought between 1600AD and 1973AD. Descriptive data include battle name, date, and location; the strengths and losses on each side; identification of the victor; temporal duration of the battle; and selected environmental and tactical environment descriptors (such as type of fortifications, type of tactical scheme, weather conditions, width of front, etc.)
This dataset is a revised, cleaned, expanded and packaged version of Helmbold's CDB90 data. However, it does not add any new battles to the data.

sources.name: U.S. Army Concepts Analysis Agency, "Database of Battles-Version 1990 (Computer Diskette)", DTIC ADM-000121, April 30, 1991.

resources.name: battles
resources.description: One row per battle (660 rows): the battle's variables, its dates and duration, coordinates, most specific Wikipedia link and per-side totals. The coded variables (`wina`, `cea`, `surpa` and others) are from the attacker's point of view: positive favors the attacker, negative the defender. Missing values are empty.

fields.name: war
fields.description: war in which battle/engagement was fought

fields.name: campgn
fields.description: campaign in which battle was fought

fields.name: front
fields.description: did defender's posture change along the front?

fields.name: depth
fields.description: did defender's posture change with depth?

fields.name: time
fields.description: did defender's posture change over time?

fields.name: aeroa
fields.description: attacker's relative air superority in theater

fields.name: quala
fields.description: degree of influence of force quality

fields.name: aira
fields.description: degree of influence of air superiority

fields.name: deepa
fields.description: degree of influence of depth of position

fields.name: is_hero
fields.description: Battle from the original HERO data (battles 1 to 600, CAA-SR-84-6, 1984); if false, the battle was added in CDB90 (Version 1990). According to the CDB90 README.TXT the added battles (about 59) come from the Data Memory Systems report "New Engagement Data for the Breakpoints Data Base" (30 September 1988, DTIC AD-A201404) together with independent research by Robert McQuie of the US Army Concepts Analysis Agency. Their strength and casualty ranges are missing.

fields.name: war2
fields.description: War name as indicated in HERO (1984) data For battles 600-660, they are assigned to the wars in the HERO 1984, or use the cdb90 war.

fields.name: war3
fields.description: War, aggregating WWI, WWI, Napoleonic Wars, and the Arab-Israeli 1967 and 1973 wars

fields.name: war4
fields.description: New war classification. Follows the wars in COW for battles after 1816, and the Wikipedia classification of wars for battles prior to that. Names are in the style of COW wars.

fields.name: war4_theater
fields.description: War theater. Only used for the larger wars.

fields.name: cow_warno
fields.description: Correlates of War (COW) war number of the war in which the battle occured.

fields.name: cow_warname
fields.description: Correlates of War (COW) war name of the war in which the battle occured.

fields.name: war_initiator
fields.description: Was attacker in the battle on the side of the war initiator. This uses the COW war initiator coding for battles in COW wars, and the author's coding for battles not in COW wars.

fields.name: parent
fields.description: ``isqno`` of a parent battle in the data. If not null, then the observation is a duplicated battle.

fields.name: datetime
fields.description: Battle date and time (mid-point). This is simply the midpoint of ``datetime_min`` and ``datetime_max``.

fields.name: duration_days
fields.description: Battle duration in days, calculated from `datetime_min` and `datetime_max` (`duration1` in the relational table `battle_durations`).

fields.name: duration_active_days
fields.description: Battle duration in days, calculated from the durations of the battle's active periods (`duration2` in `battle_durations`).

fields.name: front_width_attacker
fields.description: Width of the attacker's front at the start of the battle (km).

fields.name: front_width_defender
fields.description: Width of the defender's front at the start of the battle (km).

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Latitude (WGS 84, decimal degrees) from Wikidata; empty for 5 battles.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Longitude (WGS 84, decimal degrees) from Wikidata; empty for 5 battles.

fields.name: coordinate_precision
fields.description: What the coordinates are: `battle` (the battle's own Wikidata item), `place` (the place where the action took place or that it is named after), `area` (a town, commune or district the HERO narrative puts the action in or beside), `campaign` (an operation or campaign it was part of), `region` (a larger area) or `war`. A campaign's point is shared by all its battles.

fields.name: wikidata_id
fields.description: Wikidata item of the most specific linked article (battle, then campaign, then war).

fields.name: wikipedia_title
fields.description: English Wikipedia article of that item.

fields.name: link_match
fields.description: How specific that link is: `battle` (an article on this battle), `campaign` (the smallest operation or campaign that covers it) or `war`.

fields.name: attacker_actors
fields.description: Actors (states or non-states) on the attacker's side, separated by ` & `.

fields.name: defender_actors
fields.description: Actors on the defender's side, separated by ` & `.

fields.name: attacker_str
fields.description: Total personnel strength of the attacker (`str` in `belligerents`).

fields.name: defender_str
fields.description: Total personnel strength of the defender.

fields.name: attacker_cas
fields.description: Battle casualties of the attacker (`cas` in `belligerents`).

resources.name: narratives
resources.description: One row per battle that has a narrative (610 rows): the narrative, its significance and its sources, parsed from the OCR text of CAA-SR-84-6 (the HERO volumes) and of the 1988 report "New Engagement Data for the Breakpoints Data Base". The first 600 battles of CDB90 are described in the volumes; 585 of them have a narrative in the OCR text, and so does battle 601. The 1988 report has the 24 battles 602 to 625. The other 15 of the first 600 are battles of the 1967 and 1973 Arab-Israeli wars that the volumes list only in a table of contents, and a few others; 626 to 660 have no narrative. The sources are full citations, one per line.

fields.name: hero_volume
fields.description: Volume of CAA-SR-84-6 (II to VI) the narrative is in; empty for the 1988 report.

fields.name: hero_title
fields.description: The heading of the narrative, with the battle's name and dates as printed.

fields.name: narrative
fields.description: The narrative, in paragraphs separated by a blank line.

fields.name: sources
fields.description: The sources of the narrative, one full citation per line. The volumes give codes such as `M.19` or `B.11.1`; each is replaced by the entry of the bibliography at the end of the volumes, and `(vol. 1)` after a citation is the volume of a multi-volume work. The 1988 report lists its sources by operation, so the engagements of an operation share one list.

fields.name: document
fields.description: The document the narrative is from: a volume of CAA-SR-84-6 or the 1988 report "New Engagement Data for the Breakpoints Data Base" (AD-A201404).

resources.name: sides
resources.description: One row per battle and side (1,320 rows): the side's forces, commanders and outcome, with the battle's name, war, year and coordinates.

fields.name: is_attacker
fields.description: Whether the side is the attacker.

fields.name: code
fields.description: indicates interpretation of total personnel strength

fields.name: fly
fields.description: number of close air support sorties

fields.name: ach
fields.description: mission accomplishment score; on scale of 1 to 10, 1=low

fields.name: actors
fields.description: Actor(s), state or nonstate, of the belligerent. If more than one actor, actors are separated by " & ".

fields.name: commander_names
fields.description: Names of the side's commanders (from `commanders`), separated by `; `. Empty for 95 sides. `co` is the commander as written in the original data.

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: Outcome for this side: 1 win, 0 draw, -1 loss. Derived from `wina`, which is from the attacker's point of view. Empty for 4 sides (2 battles).

fields.name: war
fields.description: War in which the battle was fought.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Year of the battle's mid-point date.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Latitude of the battle (WGS 84, decimal degrees); see `battles`.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Longitude of the battle (WGS 84, decimal degrees).
